feature.title: Compose button for new tickets
feature.notes: Bottom-right compose control on mobile. Opens a sheet to file bug/feature/set/compat with title, notes, optional pictures. Mints next id, writes log XML, bumps nextIds. Verify: open a project, tap compose, file a bug, it appears in All.

feature.title: Theme button with vertical flyout
feature.notes: Bottom-left theme control. Vertical flyout: Dark, Dim, Light. Persist via tracker-theme cookie (1 year, SameSite=Lax). Boot script applies before paint. Verify: pick Light, reload, theme remains.
